<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" id="Definitions_FridgeService" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/fridge-service">
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Symptoms" name="Symptoms and fridge type"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Request" name="Service request"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Appointment" name="Appointment"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_RepairDone" name="Repair completed"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Rating" name="Service rating"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collab_FridgeService">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Customer" name="Customer" processRef="Process_Customer"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Central" name="Central fridge service center" processRef="Process_Central"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Facility" name="Local service facility" processRef="Process_Facility"/>

    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_Symptoms" sourceRef="Task_SendSymptoms" targetRef="Start_Request"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_Request" sourceRef="Task_ForwardRequest" targetRef="Start_ServiceRequest"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_Appointment" sourceRef="Task_SendAppointment" targetRef="Catch_Appointment"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_RepairDone" sourceRef="Task_NotifyRepaired" targetRef="Catch_RepairDone"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_Rating" sourceRef="Task_Rate" targetRef="Start_Rating"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Customer" name="Customer" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Customer" name="Fridge produces strange noises"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendSymptoms" name="Send symptoms and fridge type" messageRef="Msg_Symptoms"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_Appointment" name="Appointment received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_Appointment" messageRef="Msg_Appointment"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_RepairDone" name="Repair completion received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_RepairDone" messageRef="Msg_RepairDone"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ConfirmRepair" name="Confirm fridge works again"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Rate" name="Rate service facility?"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_Rate" name="Rate service facility" messageRef="Msg_Rating"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Rated" name="Service rated"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Completed" name="Repair confirmed"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_C1" sourceRef="Start_Customer" targetRef="Task_SendSymptoms"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_C2" sourceRef="Task_SendSymptoms" targetRef="Catch_Appointment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_C3" sourceRef="Catch_Appointment" targetRef="Catch_RepairDone"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_C4" sourceRef="Catch_RepairDone" targetRef="Task_ConfirmRepair"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_C5" sourceRef="Task_ConfirmRepair" targetRef="Gateway_Rate"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_C6" name="Customer wants to rate" sourceRef="Gateway_Rate" targetRef="Task_Rate">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression>Customer wants to rate</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_C7" name="Customer does not rate" sourceRef="Gateway_Rate" targetRef="End_Completed">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression>Customer does not rate</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_C8" sourceRef="Task_Rate" targetRef="End_Rated"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Central" name="Central fridge service center" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Request" name="Symptoms and fridge type received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_Symptoms" messageRef="Msg_Symptoms"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SelectFacility" name="Select local service facility"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_ForwardRequest" name="Forward request to local service facility" messageRef="Msg_Request"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Forwarded" name="Request forwarded"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_D1" sourceRef="Start_Request" targetRef="Task_SelectFacility"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_D2" sourceRef="Task_SelectFacility" targetRef="Task_ForwardRequest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_D3" sourceRef="Task_ForwardRequest" targetRef="End_Forwarded"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Facility" name="Local service facility" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_ServiceRequest" name="Service request received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_Request" messageRef="Msg_Request"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_MakeAppointment" name="Make appointment"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendAppointment" name="Send appointment to customer" messageRef="Msg_Appointment"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_VisitMerge" name="Customer visit"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AttemptRepair" name="Arrive at random time and attempt repair"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Repaired" name="Fridge repaired?"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_NotifyRepaired" name="Notify customer that repair is completed" messageRef="Msg_RepairDone"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Repaired" name="Repair notified"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_LeaveWithoutRepair" name="Leave without repairing (additional parts needed)"/>

    <bpmn:subProcess id="SubProc_Rating" name="Receive service rating" triggeredByEvent="true">
      <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Rating" name="Service rating received" isInterrupting="false">
        <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_Rating" messageRef="Msg_Rating"/>
      </bpmn:startEvent>
      <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Rating" name="Rating recorded"/>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_F_R1" sourceRef="Start_Rating" targetRef="End_Rating"/>
    </bpmn:subProcess>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_F1" sourceRef="Start_ServiceRequest" targetRef="Task_MakeAppointment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_F2" sourceRef="Task_MakeAppointment" targetRef="Task_SendAppointment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_F3" sourceRef="Task_SendAppointment" targetRef="Gateway_VisitMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_F4" sourceRef="Gateway_VisitMerge" targetRef="Task_AttemptRepair"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_F5" sourceRef="Task_AttemptRepair" targetRef="Gateway_Repaired"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_F6" name="Fridge repaired" sourceRef="Gateway_Repaired" targetRef="Task_NotifyRepaired">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression>Fridge repaired</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_F7" sourceRef="Task_NotifyRepaired" targetRef="End_Repaired"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_F8" name="Additional parts needed" sourceRef="Gateway_Repaired" targetRef="Task_LeaveWithoutRepair">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression>Additional parts needed</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SF_F9" sourceRef="Task_LeaveWithoutRepair" targetRef="Gateway_VisitMerge"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
